description.narrative: The objective of this HPMP Stage-II plan is to ensure that Libya#s obligation is met in terms of the Montreal Protocol#s control measures for the phasing out of remaining HCFCs consumption in manufacturing and servicing sectors to meet the 2025 targets. A total of 452.17 MT of HCFC-22 (24.87 ODPT) in the servicing sector, eligible for MLF funding and have been planned to be phased out under this program.
